_about: AnyCompany is fictional (AWS's own placeholder name). Account IDs, ARNs and the user pool ID are AWS documentation example values; emails use the reserved example.com and example.net domains (RFC 2606). Nothing here is a real credential.

idp._note: One Amazon Cognito user pool. Three app clients: the Helpdesk web app, a partner portal for contractors (same pool, different app), and a machine-to-machine client the first draft gives the agent.

users._note: What the identity provider knows after sign-in. Usernames are what the access token's username claim carries.

dana._note: A contractor. She has a partner-portal account in the same user pool and no Helpdesk access.
